Class 10–11 Chemistry · Acids, bases and pH (universal indicator)
Chemistry, visualised #12

The pH chart, from one drop of universal indicator:
Lemon juice: pH 2, red
Soda water: pH 4, orange
Milk: ? (watch the reel)
Water: pH 7, green
Baking soda: pH 8, teal
Soap: pH 10, blue
Drain cleaner: pH 13, violet
Below 7 is acidic. Above 7 is basic.
